== T24 foil photograph and printed wording ==

The card image is the unchanged T24 foil photograph by Duncan Jenkins, [[:File:Promo-Foil-L-rebelbarrier-T24-Duncan-Jenkins.jpg]]. The foil reads “Use 1 Force to target a character or starship just deployed by opponent. Target may not battle or move for remainder of turn.” The former image and transcript had the older wording. [https://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=49280 Tournament Foil, Rebel Barrier], photograph and collection of Duncan Jenkins, Star Wars Collectors Archive. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261114002816/https://swccg.com/snapshots/theswca/rebel-barrier-t24-original-385.html Internet Archive original photograph and attribution].
